beats.text: A thirty-sheet bid set arrives. Keep only the three plumbing sheets.
Name the working sheet P-101 · Plumbing Plan, then open it.
Check the scale against a printed dimension before counting anything.
Count every fixture: floor drains, sinks, water closets, lavatories.
Trace the cold water piping, from the meter out to the fixtures.
The app adds the pipe hangers at the spacing the plumbing code requires.
Trace the hot water piping, and its return line back to the water heater.
Add the 3 ft vertical riser where the water service comes up at the meter.
Hide the marks, then show them again, to check the sheet for anything missed.
Copy the finished takeoff into the pricing app.
